team.about: Team Vitality is a French professional esports organization which entered Counter-Strike: Global Offensive in early October 2018. They are commonly regarded as one of the most successful organizations in CS history, having won over 20 S-tier trophies, including three Majors, and being the only organization to win two consecutive ESL Grand Slams. Vitality is best known for its French-turned-international lineup, which has notably featured Mathieu "ZywOo" Herbaut and long-time in-game leader Dan "apEX" Madesclaire.

team.about: G2 Esports (formerly known as Gamers2) is a German professional esports organization based in Berlin, created by former League of Legends player Carlos "ocelote" Rodríguez Santiago. The organization also hosts squads in Counter-Strike 2, League of Legends, Hearthstone, Rocket League, Vainglory, Paladins, PUBG and Super Smash Bros Melee.
